WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) as rental_total
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
store_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    store_id,
    AVG(rental_total) as store_avg
  FROM rental_totals
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT 
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.rental_total) as total_of_kept,
  AVG(rt.rental_total - sa.store_avg) as avg_difference
FROM rental_totals rt
JOIN store_avgs sa ON rt.store_id = sa.store_id
WHERE rt.rental_total > sa.store_avg
GROUP BY rt.store_id
ORDER BY rt.store_id
